item.title: Tencent Kicks Off $5 Billion Bond Sale to Finance AI Spending
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Tencent Holdings Ltd. began marketing dollar and offshore yuan bonds in an offering that could raise around $5 billion to support its escalating investments in artificial intelligence. The Chinese technology and gaming giant has set initial price guidance for its proposed 10-year and 20-year dollar bonds at around 115 and 140 basis points above comparable US Treasuries, respectively, according to a person familiar with the matter.
